id.description: Fabric-namespaced item id. {PROJECT}-S{n} = laptop fabric; {PROJECT}-Z-S{n} = site Z. The fabric coordinate is REQUIRED for site Z because both certifiers otherwise allocate the same sequence by construction -- measured 2026-08-21: 7 colliding ids, 14 distinct findings, zero identical. Bridged messages cite the namespaced id.

class.description: INTERRUPTION RIGHT -- what the item does to the current turn. Orthogonal to hazard_standing. RULED FORM (CTO @a35da72725): 'latent hazard' is the PROSE name for (any class, ARMED), never an enum value.

hazard_standing.description: Whether the item, LEFT ALONE, harms through the process's FUTURE NORMAL operation. Orthogonal to class: a BLOCKING or OBSERVATION item may also be ARMED, and then it carries a disarm owner. Replaced the removed precedence rule (channel item NFRA_PIPELINE-S1).

spec_asserts.description: STEP-7 TRIGGER, half 1: what the TO SAID, quoted or paraphrased tightly. Paired with `world_is`. The trigger is 'did I have to do something the TO did not say to do, or could I not do something the TO said to do?' -- a SPEC-vs-WORLD MISMATCH. Carrying BOTH halves is what keeps the worker judging FORM and never SIGNIFICANCE: a row that cannot state both is not a mismatch, it is an opinion. OPTIONAL in this schema and REQUIRED BY THE GATE ON NEW ROWS ONLY (.tools/surprise-row-gate.py) -- ~190 rows predate the field and are not back-filled, per Andrew-direct 2026-09-01 'this is a relatively new system ... maintain now and prospectively'.

world_is.description: STEP-7 TRIGGER, half 2: what the WORLD turned out to be. Paired with `spec_asserts`. See that field for the trigger, the prospective-only bound, and why both halves are required together.

allOf.comment: graduation is a GROUNDING bar: a GRADUATED item must be GROUNDED with nonempty evidence
a bare dismissal is the rot with a tidier label
ARMED obliges a named disarm owner WHATEVER the class -- this is the case the removed precedence rule could not express (the tsc specimen: OBSERVATION class, ARMED standing)
